title: Responsible use
lead: Football is unpredictable. Our numbers are probabilities, not promises.

sections.heading: What our predictions are
paragraphs: GoalGrid estimates how likely each result is. Estimates can be wrong, and favourites lose often. A prediction is a way to understand a match, not a way to know its result.

sections.heading: GoalGrid is not betting advice
paragraphs: We do not take bets, handle money on matches or recommend bets. Bookmaker odds appear on GoalGrid as information about what the market thinks. They are not an invitation to place a bet.

sections.heading: If you choose to bet
bullets: Only stake money you can afford to lose.
Set a limit before you start and keep to it.
Do not bet to solve money problems.
Take regular breaks and do not bet when tired, upset or drinking.
Betting is for adults only, and it is not legal everywhere. Follow the law where you live.

sections.heading: Warning signs
bullets: Spending more time or money than you intended.
Hiding your betting from people close to you.
Feeling anxious or irritable when you are not betting.
Betting to win back what you have lost.

sections.heading: Where to get help
paragraphs: These organisations are independent of GoalGrid and offer free, confidential support:
bullets: [BeGambleAware](https://www.begambleaware.org) for support in the United Kingdom.
[GamCare](https://www.gamcare.org.uk) for the National Gambling Helpline and online chat in the United Kingdom.
[National Council on Problem Gambling](https://www.ncpgambling.org) for help in the United States.
sections.note: If you are in another country, search for your national gambling helpline.

sections.heading: Our community
paragraphs: Prediction challenges are played for points only. There is no money, no stakes and no prizes of value. Posts that promote gambling offers or tipsters are removed.

sections.heading: Age
paragraphs: GoalGrid is for people aged 18 or over, or the age of majority where you live.

sections.heading: Tell us
paragraphs: If you see something on GoalGrid that encourages irresponsible gambling, [contact us](/contact) and we will review it.
